name: Skyquake LoginForge
author: pranavmundre

sections.description:
Skyquake LoginForge allows administrators to easily customize the WordPress login page. Features include:

  • Upload custom login logo using WordPress media uploader
  • Set custom redirect URL for the logo
  • Adjust logo width and height
  • Live preview of the logo in the admin panel
  • Choose from pre-designed login themes (Default Clean, Dark Mode, Gradient Style)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the skyquake-loginforge folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Skyquake LoginForge in your WordPress admin menu to configure the options
